rules.cell: A cell is the awarding agency code as recorded (3 characters, or 4 for agencies identified by a FREC code) x product or service code (PSC) x fiscal year. A blank PSC is its own value.
rules.vendor: A vendor is recipient_parent_uei, or recipient_uei when the parent is blank. Rows with both blank form one vendor, '(no ID)'.
rules.negative_vendors: A vendor-cell is negative when the sum of federal_action_obligation over its rows is below zero. Counted by fiscal year: cells, vendor-cells, negative vendor-cells, the summed net of negative vendor-cells, and cells holding at least one negative vendor-cell. Variants: full PSC, PSC cut to its first 2 characters, and full PSC with the ten rows of the five reversal pairs removed (diagnostic only). Deobligation-flag attribution: for each negative vendor-cell, the net of its rows flagged 'deobligation larger than the award's obligations that year'; the vendor-cell counts as explained by those rows when removing them leaves a net of zero or more.
rules.hhi: For illustration only: HHI = 10,000 x the sum of squared shares, where a share is a vendor's net divided by the summed net of vendors with a positive net in the cell. Vendors with a net of zero or less get no share.
rules.figure1_diagnostic: Diagnostic line, not the data: FY2008 net minus the Emerson entry plus the Emerson pair's net; FY2009 net minus the Emerson reversal; FY2010 net minus the two $10,000,000,000 US Mint rows. Every other year as recorded.
rules.bands: Amount bands by federal_action_obligation: negative; zero; under $3,000; $3,000 to under $3,500; $3,500 to under $10,000; $10,000 to under $250,000; $250,000 and over; unparseable.
rules.row_jumps: Row-count differences between two fiscal years, broken down by awarding agency and sub-agency, by order type (award type code, or 'IDV ' + IDV type for contract vehicles), and by amount band. Late reporting means initial_report_date (as a UTC date) more than 90 days after action_date.
rules.mfa_cells: Rows whose recipient_name (trimmed, upper case) is MISCELLANEOUS FOREIGN AWARDEES. For each cell with a positive net, the share is their net divided by the cell's net. Reported: cells where the share is above 10%, as a count and the top 20 by their dollars.
rules.dual_codes: An agency name (trimmed, upper case) that appears with at least one 3-character code and at least one 4-character code in the same column pair (awarding_agency_code with awarding_agency_name, or funding_agency_code with funding_agency_name) across FY2008 to FY2025. Reported with rows and net dollars for each code.
rules.parent_tests: Population: the units that changed hands, as every row in the window of each recipient_uei that matches the unit rule at least once in that window. Raytheon, Sikorsky and L3 units are found by recipient name (RAYTHEON COMPANY, as in version 1; any name containing SIKORSKY; names starting L3 or L-3). Spun-off SAIC units are found by the new SAIC parent ID, because old and new SAIC share one name. Corrected after a first run, whose population (any unit carrying either parent ID) mixed in units of United Technologies and Harris that never changed hands, because those parents' IDs carried over to RTX and L3Harris. Counted: rows per month by the parent ID recorded on the row (before, after, other or blank). Switch month: the first month in which rows carrying the after ID outnumber rows carrying the before ID. Anachronistic rows: rows carrying the after ID more than one month before the event month.
rules.early_rows: Rows carrying the new parent ID dated before the closing date in the SEC filing, and more than 30 days before it.
rules.display_names: Display name of a parent ID in a year: the most common recipient_parent_name_raw on rows carrying that ID in that year.
rules.funding_999: Rows whose funding_agency_code is 999, counted with their net dollars by fiscal year.
rules.mint_children: Rows whose parent_award_id_piid is TMHQ10C0040 or TMHQ10C0044 (orders placed under the two US Mint contract vehicles), counted with their net dollars by fiscal year and vehicle.
